description: This source file contains unit tests for the DrugOrderValidator class within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It tests validation logic for drug orders, including proper handling of required fields, data consistency, and business rules.

classes.name: DrugOrderValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the logic of DrugOrderValidator in various scenarios including field validations, order saving rules, and business constraints.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAsNeededIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the 'asNeeded' field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDosingTypeIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the 'dosingType' field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailValidationIfDrugIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when 'drug' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required fields are correctly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfQuantityIsNullForOutpatientCareSetting
methods.description: Checks that quantity validation fails when care setting is outpatient and quantity is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNumberOfRefillsIsNullForOutpatientCareSetting
methods.description: Ensures that number of refills validation fails when care setting is outpatient and refills is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailValidationIfQuantityAndNumRefillsAreNullIfConfiguredToNotRequire
methods.description: Validates behavior when global properties disable requirements for quantity and refills.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDoseIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when dose is null for SimpleDosingInstructions type.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDoseUnitsIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when doseUnits is null for SimpleDosingInstructions type.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRouteIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when route is null for SimpleDosingInstructions type.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFrequencyIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when frequency is null for SimpleDosingInstructions type.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDosingInstructionsIsNullForFreeTextDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when dosingInstructions is null for FreeTextDosingInstructions type.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDoseUnitsIsNullWhenDoseIsPresent
methods.description: Tests validation failure when doseUnits is null while dose is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfQuantityUnitsIsNullWhenQuantityIsPresent
methods.description: Tests validation failure when quantityUnits is null while quantity is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDurationUnitsIsNullWhenDurationIsPresent
methods.description: Tests validation failure when durationUnits is null while duration is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDrugConceptIsDifferentFromOrderConcept
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when the concept of the drug differs from the order concept.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotRequireAllFieldsForADiscontinuationOrder
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when an order is a discontinuation of an active order, with minimal fields.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDoseUnitsIsNotADoseUnitConcept
methods.description: Tests validation failure when doseUnits concept is not a recognized dose unit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfQuantityUnitsItNotAQuantityUnitConcept
methods.description: Tests validation failure when quantityUnits concept is not a recognized quantity unit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDurationUnitsIsNotADurationUnitConcept
methods.description: Checks validation failure when durationUnits concept isn't a proper duration unit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfRouteIsNotAValidConcept
methods.description: Checks validation failure when route concept isn't among allowed concepts.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptIsNullAndDrugIsNotSpecified
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if both concept is null and no drug is specified.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptIsNullAndCannotInferItFromDrug
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if concept is null and cannot be inferred from the drug.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfConceptIsNullAndDrugIsSet
methods.description: Verifies validation passes if concept is null but drug is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfConceptIsNullAndDrugNonCodedIsSet
methods.description: Verifies validation passes if concept is null but a non-coded drug name is provided.

methods.name: validate_shouldApplyValidationForACustomDosingType
methods.description: Tests validation restrictions when custom dosing instructions are used.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotValidateACustomDosingTypeAgainstAnyOtherDosingTypeValidation
methods.description: Ensures custom dosing instructions are not validated against other dosing types.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldFailDrugOrderWithoutADrugWhenDrugOrderRequireDrugGBIsTrue
methods.description: Tests that saving a drug order without a drug fails if global property mandates a drug.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldPassDrugOrderWithoutADrugWhenDrugOrderRequireDrugGBIsFalse
methods.description: Tests that saving a drug order without a drug passes if global property allows it.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldPassDrugOrderWithoutADrugWhenDrugOrderRequireDrugGBIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures saving succeeds when the global property is unset.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldFailIfDurationUnitsHasNoMappingToSNOMEDCTSource
methods.description: Verifies failure when duration units don't map to SNOMED CT codes.

methods.name: validate_shouldValidateFieldLengths
methods.description: Tests that fields with proper length are validated successfully.

methods.description: Tests that overly long field values trigger validation errors.
